quote.text: I have not kept any records and need to catch up

promise.text: How to catch up on homeschool records you did not keep

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "record"

lines.text: What you can rebuild from workbooks, photos, receipts and library history, and how to mark it as reconstructed.

head.text: Gather workbooks, receipts and your phone.

body.text: Sort photos by date, newest first.

head.text: Write one line per subject per week you can place: date range, subject, how far you got.
Add library and calendar entries as reading and co-op days.
Check what your state actually asks for before doing any more than that.
Record today's session properly, so tomorrow starts the habit instead of another gap.

line.text: It works from whatever you give it. Record what you did, when you can remember it, and the record builds from there rather than demanding a full year up front.
